description: Detail for a single source by name, the same row list_sources returns. Returns kind, item_count, last_update, next_sync, freshness_status, and description; for a postgresql.org list also poll: the list poller's p_new (probability of mail we lack since its last poll), due, next_poll, factors and the last poll's outcome.

kind.description: Only this kind (inbox, repository, docs, wiki, discord, legacy): a name two kinds share (psqlodbc is an inbox and a repository) otherwise answers the inbox.

name.description: A name list_sources returns: an inbox (pgsql-hackers), a repository (postgres), pg-docs, pg-wiki, pg-discord or legacy. A kind with one source (wiki, docs, discord) names that source.

name: get_source_info
